1.guide: This is the platinum, and it unlocks on its own once every other trophy in the game has been earned. There is nothing separate to do for it — treat it as the reward for finishing the rest of this list.

10.guide: Complete the story mission 'Child's Play'. Progress through the campaign and the trophy is awarded when this mission ends.

11.guide: Complete the story mission 'Headliners'. It is a named campaign mission, so it unlocks through ordinary story progression with no extra conditions stated.

12.guide: Complete the story mission 'VCIA Takedown'. The name ties it to the VCIA, but the description adds no extra conditions — finishing the mission in the campaign is what counts.

13.guide: Complete the story mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. Play through the campaign and this unlocks when the mission is finished.

14.guide: Attain 100% completion as the game itself tracks it. The description doesn't break down what feeds the percentage, so use the in-game completion stat as your checklist and expect the story plus side content — strands, activities, collectibles and challenges — to count toward it.

15.guide: Complete 250 stunts. The description gives a total but no locations, so treat every stunt opportunity you come across while exploring as progress, keep a rough count, and revisit stunt spots until the 250 total is met.

16.guide: Try each type of activity once. Other trophies on this list point to the kinds on offer — races, shooting range challenges, fishing, drone races, arcade games — so start one of each type at least once; you only need to try them, not win.

17.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Work through the range's full set of challenges and replay any where you fall short of gold until every one of them is gold.

18.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There is more than one drone race location, and a location only counts once you have won there — entering or finishing lower doesn't register.

19.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race doesn't add to the count, so keep moving on to new race events across the map until you have 20 distinct wins.

2.guide: Finish the story mission 'Gone Fishing'. It sits early in the campaign, before the Chapter 1 completion trophy, so simply start playing through the story and this pops when the mission ends.

20.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take on Cal's fishing challenge and finish ahead of him; if an attempt falls short, challenge him again until you come out on top.

21.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine or venue and play one of its games through to the end — the description asks for a completion, not just a quick try.

22.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, which closes out his stranger strand. Work through Andy's missions as they appear on the map until the last one is done.

23.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, finishing his stranger strand. Follow Kenton's chain of missions through to the final one to earn this.

24.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, which wraps up his stranger strand. Play Billy's missions as they unlock until you finish the last one.

25.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger; the strands ending with the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are among those that count toward the eight.

26.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, closing out his stranger strand. Work through Randy's missions as they appear until the final one is complete.

27.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, finishing his stranger strand. Follow Tyrone's chain of missions through to the last one to earn this.

28.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The spots are spread over the whole state, so this pairs naturally with full map exploration — meditate at each spot you find until all of them are done.

3.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Chapter trophies are awarded automatically as each chapter concludes, so steady progress through the campaign is all this requires.

4.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Like the other chapter trophies, this one unlocks automatically at the moment the chapter ends.

5.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. Keep following the campaign after Chapter 2 and this is awarded when the chapter wraps up.

6.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. This is the last numbered chapter before the finale, and the trophy is awarded automatically when it ends.

7.guide: Finish the game's final mission to close out the campaign. This gold trophy follows on from Chapter 4 and is awarded for completing that last mission.

8.guide: Complete the story mission 'Breakfast Run'. It is one of the named campaign missions, so play through the story and this unlocks when the mission is finished.

9.guide: Complete the story mission 'The Cartel Heist'. It belongs to the main campaign, so it unlocks as you finish the mission during normal story progression.
